note: Switzerland County (IN) publishes its zoning ordinance as PDF/legal text only. The county planning page links no zoning map or GIS service. The county web map (switzerlandin.wthgis.com) exposes no ArcGIS REST endpoint (404 on /arcgis/rest/services) and no zoning layer was found. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Switzerland County zoning returned no queryable district layer. Vevay's code (codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/vevayin) lists zoning map changes only as text; no city GIS zoning layer was found.
